secrets.name: OAUTH_SERVER_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of the external OAuth server (only needed for login features)

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign session cookies (placeholder used in dev)

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Forge API key, if AI/storage features are used

secrets.name: SMTP_URL
secrets.description: SMTP connection string for sending password reset emails (e.g. smtp://user:pass@host:port). Optional — in dev without it, reset links are logged to the server console.
